definitions.explanation: The official currency of Japan. Symbol: ¥.
A round shape. The kanji literally means 'round/circle'.

examples.japanese: ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{百|ひゃく}→百：00780_hyaku⟧{円|えん}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
⟦{五百|ごひゃく}→五百：12738_gohyaku⟧{円|えん}⟦{払|はら}いました→払う：00535_harau⟧。

examples.english: Please give me two 1000 yen bills.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{二千|にせん}→二千：00976_nisen⟧{円|えん}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。

examples.english: This is expensive. Do you have something a little cheaper? I'm looking for something around 3000 yen.

⟦{丸|まる}い→丸い：02967_marui⟧{円|えん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|か}きました→描く：02013_egaku⟧。
⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦たち→達：01551_tachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{円|えん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{座|すわ}っています→座る：00757_suwaru⟧。

examples.english: We all danced in a circle. It was a lot of fun.

notes:
SENSE 1 — CURRENCY:
The {円|えん} has been Japan's official currency since 1871. Symbol: ¥.

COINS:
- 1{円|えん}, 5{円|えん}, 10{円|えん}, 50{円|えん}, 100{円|えん}, 500{円|えん}

BILLS:
- 1000{円|えん}, 5000{円|えん}, 10000{円|えん}

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{円高|えんだか}→円高：04852_endaka⟧: strong yen (yen appreciates against other currencies)
- ⟦{円安|えんやす}→円安：04854_enyasu⟧: weak yen (yen depreciates)
- ⟦ご{縁|えん}→ご縁：08773_goen⟧: connection, fate (the 5{円|えん} coin is considered lucky because ⟦ご{縁|えん}→ご縁：08773_goen⟧ sounds like 5{円|えん})

SENSE 2 — CIRCLE:
- {円|えん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|えが}く→描く：02013_egaku⟧: to draw a circle
- {円|えん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to form a circle
- ⟦{半円|はんえん}→半円：30441_hanen⟧: semicircle
- ⟦{円形|えんけい}→円形：11674_enkei⟧: circular shape
- ⟦{丸|まる}→丸：02167_maru⟧: circle as a drawn mark or shape (the everyday word; {円|えん} is the geometric term)
